implementationReview.delta: Extend existing strict frame review-marker requirement to html_document_preload, plus a narrow document-preload DOM branch.
requiredAdmissionChecks: Explicit curated reviewed-gap-additions entry; sourceId present in bound packet.
Actual zoned sourceObservedAt and reviewedAt; sourceObservedAt matches source.
Lowercase 64-digit SHA required; review SHA equals packet SHA and actual cached bytes.
Latest root status ok and no explicit root/robots/auth/challenge/prior access boundary.
Actual parsed link element, rel token preload, as=document, exact literal nonempty href.
urljoin(source.sourceUrl,literal href) exactly matches request_key(entry.url), preserving scheme/host/www/port/path/query.
Target host equals source host; public-origin validation and transport remain unchanged.
antiSpoofCoverage: Script literal and script redirect are not link nodes.
HTML comments and CSS/style pseudo-links are not link nodes.
Anchor/image tags and stylesheet/style/image/missing-as/preloader links do not qualify.
A document preload without an explicit reviewed entry is not automatically discovered.
boundaries: Discovery only; not an entity acceptance, scientific statement, redirect observation or canonical-URL migration.
No changes outside plan: loader, safe_url adapter, transport, TLS, shared host gate, retry/deadlines, one-shot journal, caps and execution checks are AST-identical to base.

reviewedEntry.label: reviewed displayed frame or document entry target
reviewedEntry.reason: Actual captured root names a literal same-site displayed frame or document-preload target. No prior target capture/attempt/refusal or active host conflict was found. Read target body to assess whole-lab scope; navigation, constant JavaScript and page title alone do not establish research. No script execution, protocol substitution, HTTP redirect or canonical migration.

actualRomero.actualCSSAndScriptNotUsed: The root contains stray anchor-looking CSS and a window.location.href script. Neither contributes to admission; the literal link document preload is sufficient. No script was executed.
